top_issues: 'Spendable now $182.99' is larger than 'Total balance $162.99' with no derivation shown — Rosa/Ingrid cannot reconcile the two numbers.
Left and right columns both dead-end in large empty regions below the fold; the screen wastes its own grid.
fixes: Add a one-line derivation under Spendable: 'total $162.99 + inbound credit room $20.00'.
Promote the 'Two colours, one rule' card into a dismissible tooltip and pull the Balances list up to fill the gap.

top_issues: The 'To' field shows a raw entity id (0x92c2…) under 'H2'; a non-technical payer has no contact book to pick from.
Before/After account panel is excellent but sits disconnected from the Amount field it explains.
fixes: Add a contacts/recipient picker above the raw id with the id as a secondary line.
Anchor the Before/After delta card directly beneath the Amount bar so cause and effect read as one block.

top_issues: 'Settled 05:11:57 in 8s' mixes wall-clock and latency without a label; Elena may misread 'in 8s' as a future time.
Proof hash truncated to 0xec9904be…68e4 with no full-copy affordance on the row itself.
fixes: Relabel as 'Settled 05:11:57 · took 8 s'.
Make the Proof row a tap-to-copy control with a visible copy glyph.

top_issues: QR dominates while the '45.50 capacity via H1' warning is small grey text top-right of the amount field — easy to miss before sharing.
Two share CTAs (Copy payment link, Print/PDF) plus a collapsed 'Other ways' stack feel redundant for a counter flow Priya uses all day.
fixes: Turn the capacity figure into a colored chip adjacent to the QR.
Merge Print/PDF into the 'Other ways to share' disclosure.

top_issues: The primary 'Swap USDC for WETH' CTA is disabled and pushed to the very bottom, far from the inputs and from the red 'Prepare incoming capacity before swapping' gate.
Collateral slider, three preset buttons, a 10%-buffer checkbox, an 'Extend credit limit' button and a four-line tariff paragraph all compete inside one card — Wei sees price, Lucas sees noise.
fixes: Make the gating a single inline step above the CTA and keep the CTA sticky at the bottom.
Collapse the tariff paragraph behind a 'fee details' disclosure.

top_issues: The floating tooltip ('Account opening requested with zero credit…') overlaps the collateral slider and the 'Collateral / New credit' values, hiding the state Aisha must read.
LEGS panel uses hollow radio-style bullets that look interactive but are static steps.
fixes: Render the tooltip as a non-overlapping inline banner under the slider.
Replace the LEGS bullets with numbered step markers.

top_issues: 'They owe you, uncovered $97.99' (right) and 'promised' bar (left) express the same exposure in two vocabularies; Ingrid must map them mentally.
Dispute button sits at the same visual weight as Pay/Swap, underselling how destructive it is.
fixes: Use one term ('uncovered promise') in both panels with a cross-reference.
Demote Dispute to a ghost/outline button with a confirm step.

top_issues: The dispute modal is semi-transparent over the account page; background strings ('Dispute +70.00', 'THIS ACCOUNT' rows) bleed through the modal body and the 1-2-3 explanation, making the most irreversible action unreadable.
The destructive 'Dispute this account…' button inherits the modal's low contrast and looks disabled.
fixes: Give the modal an opaque surface and a full-screen scrim; no underlying text may show through.
Set the dispute CTA to a solid danger fill with explicit 'this freezes the account' subtext.

top_issues: Status dots (settled/open/filed/created) are colour+word but the colour is the only cue in the dense right-rail alignment; Rosa reads them slowly.
'Swap filled' row shows no amount, while 'Swap placed' shows 20.00 USDC — inconsistent row anatomy.
fixes: Add a tiny status glyph beside each dot so meaning is not colour-only.
Show the filled amount on the 'Swap filled' row.

top_issues: Visually near-identical to 07 with no clear selected-row highlight, so the link between list row and detail panel is ambiguous.
'2 committed entries' and 'From your runtime's committed frames' are protocol jargon that Noah needs but Priya does not.
fixes: Add a persistent left accent bar on the selected row.
Provide a plain-language summary line above the technical frames line.

top_issues: The 'AT THIS SCALE' preview bars deliberately overflow their card; without the caption above the fold the effect reads as a layout bug.
Page is a single very long column; Runtime id, Frame and Vault controls are buried far below Appearance.
'Reveal recovery phrase' and 'Forget vault' sit side by side at the same prominence.
fixes: Clip the scale preview to the card with a 'fades out' hint chip so the overflow is clearly intentional.
Group Runtime + Vault into a top security card and move Appearance/Design below.

top_issues: FROM and TO both render the same three source cards with the same balances, so the user must compare two near-identical grids to see the direction of movement.
'Add to batch' is a same-size button next to the destructive-capable 'Sign & send'.
fixes: Collapse FROM/TO into a single 'from → to' selector with the delta shown once.
Make 'Add to batch' a text link under the primary action.

top_issues: Roughly the bottom half of the viewport is empty; the five entry cards and the 'where your money stands' table do not fill the canvas.
The money-stands table repeats Home's green/violet totals without a link back, risking divergence.
fixes: Add a compact accounts/lanes list to the right column to balance the grid.
Tie the totals to the same component as Home to guarantee consistency.

top_issues: The right column mixes a testnet faucet, a credit-extension slider, a disabled 'Receive USDC from H1' and three stacked destination buttons — four unrelated jobs in one rail.
All on-chain balances are 0.00 with no empty-state guidance, so the left card looks broken.
fixes: Split faucet (dev) from receiving-capacity (finance) into separate sections or screens.
Add an empty-state line: 'Nothing on-chain yet — pull from the faucet or move from reserve.'

top_issues: The H1 POOL panel shows Available/Borrowed/Active principal all 0.00, leaving the whole right side dead and giving Omar no hub economics to evaluate.
Left form is a narrow single column floating in a wide canvas; '= 1.00% per term' wraps awkwardly inside the interest field.
fixes: Add pool utilisation, APY range and a 'your position' row even when empty.
Widen the form to two columns and fix the interest helper to one line.

top_issues: One small board card in the top-left and an empty right card; ~70% of the screen is blank, which feels unfinished rather than minimal.
Threshold '1 of 1' is shown but there is no 'add signer / raise quorum' affordance despite the copy describing it.
fixes: Add an action row ('Add signer', 'Set quorum', 'Register on EntityProvider') under the board.
Use the right column for a signer list / rotation history.

top_issues: The 'PER COUNTERPARTY' card's long line ('…open → Manage → Dispute') overflows the card's right edge and is clipped.
'Enforceable right now $40.00' equals Reserve $40.00 with On-chain $0.00 and Collateral $0.00, which makes the headline number look like a copy of the sub-line.
fixes: Wrap or truncate the counterparty line with a 'View' link.
Reorder the legend so the non-zero components read first.

top_issues: The last table column header is truncated to 'CREDIT OUT·I', hiding its meaning exactly where Wei looks for exposure.
The 'Reserve·on-chain' summary row mixes green/violet/orange values into the same columns as per-lane rows, blurring totals vs positions.
fixes: Give the table horizontal scroll or abbreviate headers so none clip.
Visually separate the reserve row with a rule and a 'TOTAL' label.

top_issues: The command-palette scrim dims the left content but the right 'RECENT' column stays at full brightness, breaking the modal's depth model.
Result descriptions ('send money', 'dense console') are right-aligned grey text that competes with the labels.
fixes: Apply the scrim across the full viewport behind the palette.
Left-align descriptions or move them to a secondary line under each command.

overall.verdict: A genuinely opinionated, trust-forward wallet UI whose green-vs-violet 'yours vs promised' model and per-frame proof language are best-in-class for power users like Elena, Ingrid and Wei. It is held back by two unreadable overlay bugs (dispute modal, cross-swap tooltip), a small number of contradictory/overflowing figures (Home spendable, Desk header, Sovereignty card), and jargon-gated flows that block the simplest first-time tasks.
priority_fixes: Make the dispute modal and the cross-swap tooltip opaque and non-overlapping — the irreversible and cross-chain flows are currently unreadable.
Reconcile Home's 'Spendable now $182.99 > Total $162.99' with a one-line derivation so Rosa and Ingrid trust the headline.
Add a contacts/recipient picker on Pay and a plain-language summary on Activity so non-technical users never face raw entity ids or 'committed frames'.
Make Swap's incoming-capacity/credit gating progressive (default 0% collateral, hide the tariff lecture) so Lucas can buy a little ETH without a credit lesson.
Fix horizontal overflow/clipping (Sovereignty counterparty line, Desk column header) and fill the dead whitespace on Manage/Ownership/Lend.
